name: Starting Strength
author: Mark Rippetoe
programDescription: The classic novice linear progression. Two alternating workouts (A and B), three days per week. Add weight every session — 5 lb upper body, 10 lb lower — until you stall. Five core lifts, simple and brutal.

days.name: Workout A
days.notes: Squat, bench, deadlift. The deadlift is one work set — pull it hard, then go home.

exercises.notes: 3 work sets across after warmups. Add 10 lb next session if all reps clean.
3 work sets across. Add 5 lb next session if all reps clean.
One work set of 5 after warmups. Add 10 lb next session if clean.

days.name: Workout B
days.notes: Squat, press, power clean. Power cleans are 5 sets of 3 — speed and intent.

exercises.notes: 3 work sets across. Squat every session — yes, even today.
3 work sets across. Add 5 lb next session if all reps clean.
5 sets of 3 across. Add 5 lb next session if all reps fast and clean. Sub barbell rows once linear progression slows.
